title: Collateral Damage
summary: Will a trade war hurt the tanker market? As part of the ongoing effort by the U.S. administration to negotiate improved trade arrangements with China, the U.S has imposed tariffs on steel and aluminum imports and has threatened additional tariffs on other products.
